file_name: Funds managed by New Forests - Forestry plantations of AKD - third-party questionnaire_0.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if any business controlled or managed by New Forests are close competitors to AKD Estate and identify any alternative suppliers or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other for the supply of softwood logs.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with New Forests and/or AKD.
